title: Trump Calls Former Lawyer’s $50 Million Deal ‘Obnoxious and Outrageous’
summary: At a Halloween event in Florida, President Trump told reporters that Alina Habba Mildon’s lucrative work for someone seeking a pardon was “not acceptable.”
